title: Jets roster cutdown tracker with news and live updates

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets roster cutdown tracker with news and live updates
sources.description: Cutdown day is upon us. The Jets have until 6:00 pm Sunday evening to cut their roster from 90 players down to 53. With the final preseason game in the books, the Jets will get to work. I think it is fair to say that most of the cuts will not come as a surprise. […]
